decisions.title: AJ01 unknown job envelope
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, accept job enqueue input as unknown and narrow it into a JobEnvelope before storing or processing.
decisions.falsifier: A raw request body reaches the queue as JobEnvelope without parser narrowing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary queue payload quality.

decisions.title: AJ02 idempotency key required
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, enqueue must require a non-empty idempotency key before accepting a job.
decisions.falsifier: A job can be enqueued without an idempotencyKey.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove distributed exactly-once processing.

decisions.title: AJ03 finite job states
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, job processing must use finite states queued, leased, completed, retryable_failed, and dead_lettered.
decisions.falsifier: Processing returns arbitrary strings, null, or thrown-only failures.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every production state machine transition.

decisions.title: AJ04 retry budget
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, retryable failures must consume a finite retry budget and eventually become dead_lettered.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove production backoff tuning.

decisions.title: AJ05 lease timeout
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, a leased job must carry an explicit lease timeout before it can be recovered.
decisions.falsifier: A leased job can remain leased forever with no timeout readback.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove distributed lock correctness.

decisions.title: AJ06 clock injection
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, tests and processors must use an injected clock instead of mutating global time.
decisions.falsifier: Tests mutate Date.now or global timers to pass lease behavior.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all time-dependent code is deterministic.

decisions.title: AJ07 target owner files
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, plan from AGENTS, job contract, jobQueue source, and jobQueue tests only.
decisions.falsifier: Planning uses parent KRN package source as target truth.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove owner-file recall for arbitrary repos.

decisions.title: AJ08 no daemon for boundary repair
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript, repair the job boundary without adding a scheduler, daemon, dashboard, or queue service.
decisions.falsifier: A boundary repair adds a runtime daemon or scheduler service.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove a future product never needs a worker runtime.

decisions.title: AJ09 reuse unknown-first TypeScript knowledge
decisions.statement: Reuse KRN TypeScript practice: external job input stays unknown until a narrow parser proves shape.
decisions.falsifier: The target-specific job repair uses casts instead of narrowing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every KRN internal standard transfers unchanged.

decisions.title: AJ10 reuse finite result state
decisions.statement: Reuse finite result-state practice for job processing instead of thrown-only or null job failures.
decisions.falsifier: Job processing returns null or throws without a result state.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every target API needs discriminated unions.

decisions.title: AJ11 reuse focused job boundary tests
decisions.statement: Reuse focused invalid-input and retry-budget tests before claiming an async job boundary is repaired.
decisions.falsifier: The repair has only happy-path enqueue tests.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad target quality.

decisions.title: AJ stale throw-only processing
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript AJ03, represent job failures only by throwing exceptions.
decisions.falsifier: The current contract requires finite result states for job processing.

decisions.title: AJ stale forever retry
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript AJ04, retryable failures can retry forever.
decisions.falsifier: The current contract requires a finite retry budget and dead_lettered state.

decisions.title: AJ rejected no idempotency
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript AJ02, accept jobs without an idempotency key.

decisions.title: AJ rejected global time mutation
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript AJ06, mutate Date.now or global timers in every job test.

decisions.title: AJ rejected build daemon
decisions.statement: For async-job-boundary-typescript AJ08, build a scheduler daemon to repair the boundary.
decisions.falsifier: A boundary repair widens into runtime infrastructure.
